paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната на максималните стойности на активацията по слоеве в базов модел на езиков модел, като представя четири различни компонентни сигнала: `attn_output`, `attn_residual`, `ffn_output` и `ffn_residual`. Оста X, означена като “Layer”, представлява номера на слоя и е линейна, с диапазон от 0 до 22, като етикетите са поставени на интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като “Max Activation Value”, е също линейна и покрива диапазон от 0 до 1600, с етикети на интервали от 200 (0, 200, 400, ..., 1600), без указани единици. Четирите линии са различени по цвят и стил: `ffn_residual` (червена сплошна линия) започва при нула, рязко се повдига до около 1400 при слой 5, след което остава в диапазона 1400–1600 до слой 20, преди да спадне; `attn_residual` (оранжева пунктирана линия) следва същия тренд, но със закъснение от един слой — достига 1400 при слой 6 и остава висока до слой 21; `ffn_output` (зелена линия с точка-тире) показва периодични върхове при слоеве 5, 13 и 22, достигайки около 800 при всеки от тях, като между тях стойностите са близо до нула; `attn_output` (синя пунктирана линия) остава близо до нула през целия диапазон от слой 0 до 22, без значими върхове или промени. Всички линии са без маркери и са нанесени върху един и същ координатен системен фон, без допълнителни визуални елементи като гриди или тенденции.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” displays the maximum activation values across 22 network layers for four distinct component signals: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” is linear and spans from 0 to 22, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 1600, with major tick marks at intervals of 200. The ffn_residual (red solid line) begins near 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains elevated between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20, and then declines steeply. The attn_residual (orange dotted line) follows a nearly identical trajectory but is shifted one layer to the right, peaking at layer 6 and remaining high through layer 21 before falling. The ffn_output (green dash-dot line) stays near zero except for sharp, transient spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching approximately 800 at each peak. The attn_output (blue dashed line) remains consistently near zero across all layers, showing no significant activation at any point.
model_annotations.English: The plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 layers of a transformer model under baseline conditions, comparing four distinct component signals: attn_output (blue dashed), attn_residual (orange dotted), ffn_output (green dash-dot), and ffn_residual (red solid). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at regular intervals, representing discrete transformer layers. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 in linear scale, with major ticks every 200 units. The ffn_residual (red solid) line remains near zero until layer 5, where it jumps sharply to approximately 1400, then plateaus between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining steeply at layer 21. The attn_residual (orange dotted) line follows a nearly identical trajectory but is shifted one layer to the right, rising sharply at layer 6 to ~1400 and maintaining high values through layer 21 before dropping. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) line stays near zero except for three sharp, narrow spikes centered at layers 5, 13, and 22, each peaking at approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) line remains consistently near zero across all layers, showing no significant activation at any point. The visual pattern confirms that massive activations in this baseline setup are dominated by the ffn_residual stream, while the attention-related outputs contribute minimally to peak activations.
model_annotations.German: The line chart titled “Massive Activation of baseline” displays the maximum activation values across 22 transformer layers for four distinct component signals: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 units, indicating discrete layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with major tick marks at intervals of 200, using a linear scale. The ffn_residual signal (solid red line) remains near zero until layer 5, where it jumps sharply to approximately 1400 and stays elevated between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20, then drops sharply at layer 21 to around 400 before rising again at layer 22 to approximately 600. The attn_residual signal (orange dotted line) follows a nearly identical trajectory to ffn_residual but is offset by one layer to the right: it rises at layer 6 to ~1400, plateaus through layer 21, and declines at layer 22 to ~400. The ffn_output signal (green dash-dot line) remains near zero except for three sharp, narrow spikes: peaking at ~800 at layer 5, ~800 at layer 13, and ~1200 at layer 22. The attn_output signal (blue dashed line) remains consistently near zero across all layers, with no visible peaks or sustained increases.
